thesis: Precise vocabulary prevents shifts among belief, ontology, justification and civic belonging.

ideas.statement: Valid inference is not truth of premises, compatibility is not comparative confirmation, and pluralism does not imply equal evidential credibility.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Primary sources can err; authority has legitimate bounded use; documentary uncertainty is not falsity and secularity is not contempt.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Primary sources can err; authority has legitimate bounded use; documentary uncertainty is not falsity and secularity is not contempt.

audit.notes: All source units read directly. Appendix material consolidates previous analysis; bibliography and navigation excluded.
